title: Where Does The Product Come From?
purpose: Teach supply-chain flow from zero by tracing one finished product backwards.
situation: A finished NX-4 control unit is ready for customer shipment. Elena asks the learner to work backwards until every physical and information handoff makes sense.

information_flow: Planning converts demand into production requirement.
Procurement creates and manages supplier buying paths.
misconception_traps: Warehouse decides what the customer needs.
A purchase order alone means the component exists physically at Novaris.
The supplier is the beginning of every chain; upstream suppliers may exist beyond tier 1.
